# multi-AI-profile

> Universal macOS APFS copy-on-write bundle cloner and native Mach-O launcher that isolates accounts, background daemons, CLI homes, MCP configs, and AltTab/Mission Control window names for Claude Desktop, Google Antigravity, OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT, xAI Grok, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and any Electron AI app.

- Repository: https://github.com/jangtrinh/multi-AI-profile
- Documentation: https://jangtrinh.github.io/multi-AI-profile/
- License: MIT

## Core CLI Commands
- `ai-profile create <claude|antigravity|codex|chatgpt|grok|cursor|windsurf|cline|custom> "<Name>" [--color <preset|#HEX>] [--badge "<TEXT>"] [--app "/Applications/App.app"]`
- `ai-profile list [target]`
- `ai-profile remove <target> "<Name>" [--purge-data]`
